## Description

A clear and concise description of what this pull request does.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking addition to functionality)
- [ ] Protocol update (Facebook endpoint, doc ID, or payload adjustment)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / refactor

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's strict TypeScript standards (no `any`, explicit types).
- [ ] I have added vitest tests covering any bug fix or new feature.
- [ ] `pnpm run typecheck` passes with zero errors.
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes completely.
- [ ] `pnpm run build` generates dual ESM/CJS bundles cleanly.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation where appropriate.
- [ ] No personal tokens, cookies, or secrets are present in commits or test files.
